encoding/base64#

Strict RFC 4648 Base64 with explicit standard and URL-safe alphabets.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

Base64Encoded(origin: [byte(102), byte(111), byte(111)]).string();
// "Zm9v"

Base64Encoded(
    origin: [byte(251), byte(255)],
    alphabet: Base64Alphabet.url,
).string();
// "-_8="

Description#

Strict RFC 4648 Base64 with explicit standard and URL-safe alphabets.

The one-argument constructors select the standard A-Z a-z 0-9 + / alphabet. The URL-safe alphabet replaces + / with - _; it does not change padding rules. Encoding always emits canonical = padding to a multiple of four characters. Decoding requires that padding and rejects whitespace, mixed alphabets, misplaced padding and nonzero unused bits. Empty input is valid. InvalidBase64.offset() is a Unicode-scalar offset; a structurally incomplete final quantum reports origin.length().
